title: Friendly Creeper
body:
Makes the creeper neutral for 3 gunpowder. (Can be changed in the config).
The creeper will walk and will not attack players.

Default config:
```yml
item: GUNPOWDER # item that can be fed to creeper. Can be item name like "minecraft:gunpowder"
quantity: 3 # quantity which you feed to the creeper to make it neutral
```
